checkpoint.headline: M5: ESCALATED — TRANSIENT PROVIDER LIMIT
checkpoint.whereWeAre: M5 Generator produced partial, uncommitted work on the active M5 branch (`newspaper/`, newspaper content/tests, and image/config preparation), then hit the Opus session limit twice. The work remains preserved for the next Generator resumption; no deliverable code was manually committed or discarded.
checkpoint.whereWeGo: This is a transient provider-capacity failure, not a durable spec/state blocker. After the provider resets, the Coordinator may resume the M5 branch so Generator can validate, run tests, commit, push, and open the review PR. Raster images are preferred; SVG/procedural images are the approved fallback if a raster provider is unavailable.
checkpoint.nextAction: Wait for Opus capacity to reset at 23:10 UTC, then run or allow the next scheduled Coordinator invocation. It should resume the current M5 worktree rather than reset or stash it.

harnessEvolution: Introduced portable RUNBOOK and doctor check.
Added durable escalation markers and no-op short-circuits.
Split full spec into seven independently gradeable milestones.
Formalized machine-readable verdict format and scoped UNTESTABLE findings.
Disabled automatic retries for current manual Discord operation.
Added Generator-owned milestone branches and review PR lifecycle.
Defined Harness Maintainer authority: automatic knowledge/milestone/process changes; user-only spec and decision changes.
